summary.real_gdp_trough_reference: Nearly 8.75 percent below the 2022-Q4 real GDP level

additional_context.short_term_rate_description: The 3-month Treasury rate falls significantly to near zero by 2023-Q3 and remains near zero for the remainder of the scenario
additional_context.long_term_rate_description: The 10-year Treasury yield falls sharply early in the scenario and then gradually rises to approximately 1.5 percent by the end of the scenario
additional_context.yield_curve_description: The yield curve remains inverted through 2023-Q2, then becomes positively sloped and steepens over the remainder of the scenario
additional_context.commercial_real_estate_stress_context: Commercial real estate price declines are concentrated in properties most exposed to sustained income and asset-value declines, particularly offices affected by remote work and hospitality properties affected by reduced business travel
